# Bulut Karakaya

> Bulut Karakaya is a game technical leader based in Cambridge, UK, with 16+ years shipping award-winning games across mobile, PC and console. He is co-founder of Second River Games, an independent studio making AI-native simulation and management games.

Bulut led programming and technical direction on Monument Valley 3 (BAFTA-nominated for British Game) and Desta: The Memories Between at ustwo games, was lead Unity programmer on Star Trek: Fleet Command at Digit Game Studios, and has co-founded independent studios, raised seed funding and shipped original IP on Steam. He now co-founds Second River Games with Duygu Cakmak, where their first world is Village of Whispers.
